archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-08.3 Evaluate Methodological Soundness and Feasibility
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Not every idea that works technically is statistically acceptable. So, after the pilot, the result is reviewed methodologically. Experts check: - Is the method statistically valid? - Does it meet quality dimensions (accuracy, coherence, reproducibility)? - Can we explain it to users and auditors? - Does it fit our legal and ethical frameworks? If the answer is yes, the method can move forward. If not, it goes back for refinement.
Value created: Assurance that innovation does not weaken statistical quality or trust.
